item.title: ED Filed 6,444 Cases, 2,416 Chargesheets Since BJP Came into Power; Govt Tells Parliament
item.description: GUWAHATI: The central government informed Parliament on Monday, December 8, that the Enforcement Directorate has filed 6,444 money laundering cases and 2,416 charge sheets since 2014, when the Narendra Modi-led National Democratic Alliance assumed office. It said 11,106 searches were conducted under the Prevention of Money Laundering Act during this period. item.title: After Post Malone, Assam Now Eyes a Shakira Concert in Guwahati
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam Chief Minister Himanta Biswa Sarma has said that the state government is planning to bring global pop star Shakira to Guwahati. Speaking to the media, he said, “We tried for Shakira...but we want to bring her to Guwahati maybe next year or in two years. item.title: Guwahati's South Sarania Road’s Deterioration Raises Safety Concerns; PWD Cites GJB Leakage Issues
item.description: GUWAHATI: The South Sarania Road in Guwahati, a crucial arterial route connecting Ulubari, Rajgarh and Lachit Nagar, has fallen into severe disrepair, drawing concern from commuters who rely on it daily. Large craters near the slope leading to Gandhi Mandap and multiple broken stretches along the corridor have rendered the road increasingly unsafe for motorists. item.title: War over Shiva Temple Escalates as Thailand Launches Airstrikes on Cambodia
item.description: GUWAHATI: Tensions between Thailand and Cambodia intensified on Monday, December 8, as the former launched airstrikes along their disputed border following renewed clashes linked to the long-running Shiva Temple dispute. Both sides accused the other of initiating fire, with reports of military casualties and civilian evacuations. item.title: Bihar Sweep Titles as ASMITA Rugby League (East Zone) Concludes in Guwahati
item.description: GUWAHATI: The East Zone edition of the ASMITA Rugby League concluded on Sunday at the Arjun Bhogeswar Baruah Sports Complex in Guwahati, reinforcing Assam’s growing role as a hub for women’s rugby in the region. The two-day tournament brought together teams from Assam, Bihar, Jharkhand, Odisha and West Bengal, offering valuable match exposure to athletes across three age categories. item.title: Three from Assam Among 25 Dead in Goa Nightclub Fire; Three Arrested
item.description: GUWAHATI: Three persons from Assam lost their lives in a tragic fire incident at a nightclub in Arpora in Goa late Saturday night, December 6. The victims have been identified as Rahul Tanti and Manojit Mal from Cachar district, and Diganta Patir from Dhemaji district. item.title: Assam Cabinet Passes Logistics Policy, Defence School and Airport Land Transfer
item.description: GUWAHATI: The Assam Cabinet meeting held at Lok Sewa Bhawan on December 7, approved several major decisions, including land transfer for a greenfield airport in Silchar and the launch of a logistics and warehousing policy aimed at establishing Assam as a regional logistics hub. item.title: Assam Releases 35 Captive-Reared Critically Endangered Vultures for the First Time
item.description: GUWAHATI: Assam has released 30 White-rumped Vultures (Gyps bengalensis) and five Slender-billed Vultures (Gyps tenuirostris) from the Vulture Conservation and Breeding Centre (VCBC) in Rani, Guwahati, into the 6th Addition of Kaziranga National Park & Tiger Reserve under the Bishwanath Wildlife Division on December 8. item.title: It’s Great To Be In The Place of Legendary Zubeen Garg: Post Malone During Guwahati Concert
item.description: GUWAHATI: American singer and rapper Post Malone performed in Guwahati on December 8, and during his address to the crowd, he said it was “great to be in the land of legendary Zubeen Garg.” The moment drew loud cheers from fans, many of whom were still mourning the loss of the beloved Assamese icon.
